narration: Your duplicate whistle clicks from the mud-caked dead end. The sergeant turns first; the risen guards follow him in a single dragging surge, crowding the false sound instead of you. You keep the opposite wall and pass through a low service door before the illusion fades. Beyond it lies a torchlit laboratory choked with light rubble. Fine luminous threads converge above a guard’s abandoned halberd, while one section of floor refuses to hold the torchlight correctly.

payload.method: Minor Illusion reproduced the drowned sergeant’s command whistle
payload.objectiveRef: pass the risen guard crowd without fighting
